contract.rule: Pass this object—and only this object—to downstream inference.

customer_message.body:
Hello

Given the unusual circumstance: My ceiling and the downstairs neighbour's ceiling are wet again; One plumber wrote that it is the cold-water line; another named a drain; The manager acknowledges the problem but has not arranged joint access; this is how I remember it.

Regarding “recurrent multi-unit leak with conflicting contractor notes”, for this message: the leak source remains unresolved; for the request “coordinate evidence across the flats, obtain a technical cause assessment, and handle the official-deposit deadline correctly”: I currently have only part of the records; on “recurrent multi-unit leak with conflicting contractor notes”, I want clarity before acting; also unresolved: the affected units; that is the basis of my request.

I now need: coordinate evidence across the flats, obtain a technical cause assessment, and handle the official-deposit deadline correctly; in particular, I need clarity about the affected units and how the exceptional circumstance changes the route.

I became aware of the problem on 29 March 2025.

Thank you for reviewing carefully; Please clarify the leak source; Only then will I know what to do.

Kind regards
customer_message.subject: Request for a detailed review: recurrent multi-unit leak with conflicting contractor notes
